in_marathi.name: Karunakar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Karunakar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Karunakar is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘karuna’ meaning compassion and ‘karan’ meaning the doer or controller. This name signifies a compassionate deity or a person who embodies compassion and mercy.
